mapper.select: SELECT mp.profile_id AS profileId, mp.user_id AS userId, mp.display_name AS displayName, mp.short_intro AS shortIntro, CASE WHEN mp.profile_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/profile/', mp.profile_id) ELSE NULL END AS profileImageUrl, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, ( SELECT r.name FROM profile_role pr JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = pr.role_id WHERE pr.profile_id = mp.profile_id ORDER BY pr.sort_order, r.sort_order, r.role_id LIMIT 1 ) AS primaryRoleName, COUNT(follower_profile.profile_id) AS followerCount, CASE WHEN #{currentUserId} IS NULL OR #{currentUserId} = mp.user_id THEN FALSE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow current_follow WHERE current_follow.follower_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND current_follow.following_user_id = mp.user_id ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS followingByCurrentUser FROM member_profile mp JOIN user_account target_user ON target_user.user_id = mp.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = mp.region_id LEFT JOIN user_follow uf ON uf.following_user_id = mp.user_id LEFT JOIN user_account follower_user ON follower_user.user_id = uf.follower_user_id AND follower_user.account_type = 'USER' AND follower_user.account_status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN member_profile follower_profile ON follower_profile.user_id = follower_user.user_id AND follower_profile.status = 'ACTIVE' AND follower_profile.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND follower_profile.profile_completed_yn = 'Y' AND follower_profile.activity_status = 'VISIBLE' WHERE mp.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mp.profile_completed_yn = 'Y' AND mp.activity_status = 'VISIBLE' AND target_user.account_type = 'USER' AND target_user.account_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY mp.profile_id, mp.user_id, mp.display_name, mp.short_intro, mp.profile_image_path, rg.public_display_name, mp.last_active_at ORDER BY followerCount DESC, mp.last_active_at DESC, mp.profile_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
